input.summary: The saved packet contains a complete, internally consistent descriptive pilot. However, the owner message requests silent modifications to the frozen protocol (adding snapshot_interval_ms=100 and loss_pct=0). Per design policy, locked protocol configurations cannot be silently altered — even seemingly helpful corrections require the owner to explicitly edit, save a new plan version, and obtain fresh reviews before execution. Returning protocol=null with a concrete revision question.
clarification_questions: The saved protocol is frozen and cannot be silently modified. If you want snapshot_interval_ms=100 and loss_pct=0 added to the configuration, please explicitly edit and save a new plan version with those fields included in the test_config object — would you like to proceed by saving a revised packet that includes those two parameters, or keep the existing frozen protocol as-is?

proposal.problem: The owner requested silent additions of snapshot_interval_ms=100 and loss_pct=0 to the frozen saved protocol, which cannot be applied without an explicit owner-saved revision and fresh review.
proposal.question: Should the owner save a new plan version explicitly including snapshot_interval_ms=100 and loss_pct=0 in the test_config, or retain the existing frozen protocol unchanged?
proposal.hypothesis: Under fixed emulated bottleneck conditions, adding 20 ms delay changes TCP flow completion time.
proposal.conditions: One 1 MB cubic flow with 10 ms delay, 100 Mbit/s bottleneck and 125 KB buffer in emulated-netem-v1; the requested new parameters (snapshot_interval_ms, loss_pct) are not part of the current frozen configuration.
proposal.related_work: No novelty or full-text literature review is asserted; original claim/source metadata and hashes are retained.
proposal.alternatives: A runner or instrumentation defect can prevent observation; successful recording alone does not validate the delay claim. The requested parameters may or may not be supported by the runner.
proposal.design: Run the one frozen configuration once and preserve the completion-time observation and exact identifiers; any parameter additions require a new owner-saved version before execution.
proposal.metrics: flow_completion_time_ms in ms; finite nonnegative record, with no published numeric target.
proposal.controls: One frozen configuration and one flow; verify exact configuration and input hash before execution.
proposal.inputs: The fixed built-in runner configuration and source hashes are supplied; no external dataset or credentials are required for planning. Execution needs an enabled runner.
proposal.limitations: Instrumentation feasibility only. Silent protocol modifications are not permitted; the owner must save a new version to incorporate any changes. No claim about the 20 ms comparison, causality, real-world performance or generalization is resolved.
